title: MongoDB reports Q4 revenue up 27% YoY to $695.1M, vs. $670M est., and forecasts Q1 adjusted earnings per share below estimates; MDB drops 22%+ after hours (Angela Palumbo/Barron's Online)
summary: Angela Palumbo / Barron's Online: MongoDB reports Q4 revenue up 27% YoY to $695.1M, vs. $670M est., and forecasts Q1 adjusted earnings per share below estimates; MDB drops 22%+ after hours — MongoDB stock was tumbling Monday night after the document database company provided disappointing first-quarter guidance.
